name: @deepseek-plugins/cli
description: Unified CLI for DeepSeek plugins: API key management, vision analysis, balance query, skill management

scripts.build: tsup && (mv dist/cli.js dist/deepseek-plugin-cli 2>/dev/null || mv dist/cli.cjs dist/deepseek-plugin-cli) && chmod +x dist/deepseek-plugin-cli && cp dist/deepseek-plugin-cli skill/scripts/deepseek-plugin-cli && mkdir -p ../../release && cp dist/deepseek-plugin-cli ../../release/ && rm -rf ../../release/deepseek-plugin-skill && cp -r skill ../../release/deepseek-plugin-skill && cd ../../release && rm -f deepseek-plugin-skill.zip && zip -r deepseek-plugin-skill.zip deepseek-plugin-skill/ -x '*.DS_Store'
